title: Just a quick update on my tool
author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve got a quick (and not so great) update about [pixelartgen.com](http://pixelartgen.com) 😞. I ran into a storage limit and had to move everything to another platform unfortunately, that means all generated images are gone. I tried everything I could to recover them during the migration, but some errors came up and it just wasn’t possible. I’m really sorry to everyone who lost their art :( ... Now in this new platform its safe for a long term and really scalable as well

As a small apology, I’ve added 15 free credits to everyone’s account so you can create new art. On the bright side, there are lots of new updates and features based on different feedbacks I received from "VibeCodingList" (Thanks to the person who suggested me this ) I’m also working on a new model that can generate 2–3 animations at once and deliver results much faster.Umm.. so the main updates in the tool include the ability to generate “low-res” pixel art images, an improved sprite sheet flow, and a cleaner interface. I’ve also added new export options to make things easier!

Also my main focus will be on sprite sheets -> pixelart -> New types of game assetsFeel free to let me know if there is any improvements or any new features you would like to see
